note: Both sets cover the same nine drivetrain properties from Table 5-1 and the body text, with identical duplication of each fact at both component and turbine level. Set A, however, adds two unsupported conditions: 'baseline' on the rotor rated speed and 'Region 3' on the generator rated speed, neither of which appears anywhere on the page. Set B states the same values without those invented qualifiers, so it is the more faithful set. Otherwise the values, units and quotes are equivalent and correct in both.
remarks: Both sets repeat every fact twice (once as a component-level claim and once as an 'NREL 5-MW baseline wind turbine' claim), inflating the claim count without adding information. Both also omit the DOWEC reference figures (0.35 MW loss at 6.25 MW aerodynamic power, 5,025,500 kg·m² low-speed-shaft inertia) and the driveshaft natural-frequency statement (no value given), which are secondary but present on the page.
